alerts.alert_title: イラン戦争の多面的影響
alerts.description: イラン戦争関連の報道が122倍以上に急増し、経済・政治・技術など全6分野に横断して出現。単なる軍事衝突ではなく、経済制裁、エネルギー価格、国際政治の再編成に波及。中国やロシアの地政学的影響力の再配置が予想される。
alerts.alert_title_en: Multi-dimensional impact of Iran war escalation
alerts.description_en: Iran war coverage surged over 122,000% across all six PESTLE domains, indicating systemic impacts beyond military conflict. The concurrent reporting on economic effects, energy security, and geopolitical repositioning suggests major powers are recalibrating Middle Eastern strategies.

alerts.alert_title: ホルムズ海峡危機の顕在化
alerts.description: 過去2年間未出現だったホルムズ海峡話題が188件出現。米イラン衝突が海上輸送路の実存脅威化を示唆。全6分野に横断出現し、エネルギー価格、保険料、サプライチェーンなど経済実害が迫る兆候。
alerts.alert_title_en: Hormuz Strait crisis emerging as tangible threat
alerts.description_en: The Strait of Hormuz appeared 188 times across all PESTLE domains after two years of absence, signaling elevated geopolitical risk to global energy security. This new visibility suggests imminent concerns about maritime chokepoint stability.

alerts.alert_title: 米イラン交渉と石油市場連動
alerts.description: イラン交渉報道が16倍以上に急増し、株価・金価格・新興市場との連動を示唆。トランプ政権のイラン政策シフトが即座に金融市場に織り込まれており、地政学的不確実性が資産価格変動の主要因化。
alerts.alert_title_en: US-Iran talks driving commodity and equity volatility
alerts.description_en: Iran talks surge 16,000% with direct coupling to oil, gold, and emerging market movements. Markets are pricing in diplomatic outcomes in real-time, amplifying geopolitical uncertainty as a core investment risk factor.

alerts.alert_title: ハンガリー選挙の大国介入競争
alerts.description: ハンガリー選挙報道が11倍急増、米ロ両国の明示的支持が報道される。オルバン首相への米副大統領の積極支援が欧州内の民主主義価値観と秩序の軋轢を深化。中国影響力との競合も懸念される。
alerts.alert_title_en: Hungary election becomes proxy battleground for great powers
alerts.description_en: Hungary election coverage jumped 11,000%, revealing explicit US and Russian backing for competing candidates. This signals deepening geopolitical competition over European alignment and democratic norms.

alerts.alert_title: 欧州のエネルギー安保再構築
alerts.description: 欧州関連報道が180件以上、中東・湾岸諸国との安定性・成長パートナーシップを強調。ウクライナ戦争、イラン危機を受けた戦略的エネルギー確保と地政学的多角化が急速に進行中。
alerts.alert_title_en: Europe recalibrating energy security amid Gulf tensions
alerts.description_en: Europe-related coverage increased across all domains, emphasizing energy partnerships with Gulf states and Sahel stability. The region is actively diversifying geopolitical and energy dependencies to buffer against regional conflicts.

alerts.alert_title: 気候変動の多領域法制化
alerts.description: 気候関連報道が178件、経済・法律・政治に同時出現。米国での訴訟増加、州レベルのエネルギー政策遅延、保険スキームの模索が同時進行。気候リスク対応が金融・法制・エネルギー政策の統合課題化。
alerts.alert_title_en: Climate change becoming integrated regulatory and economic priority
alerts.description_en: Climate topics span all six domains with 178 instances, showing simultaneous litigation, policy delays, and insurance innovation. Climate risk is moving from isolated environmental concern to central economic and legal challenge.

alerts.alert_title: 中東紛争への技術活用拡大
alerts.description: 中東戦争報道150件が全6分野に横断、特に技術活用に注目。ドローン、AI、サイバー戦の統合的使用が新常態化。民間技術企業と軍事応用の境界が消滅、規制・倫理的課題が急速深刻化。
alerts.alert_title_en: Technology becomes central to Middle East conflict dynamics
alerts.description_en: Middle East conflict coverage (150 instances) emphasizes technology integration across drones, AI, and cyber operations. The blurring of civilian-military tech boundaries creates urgent governance and ethics challenges.

alerts.alert_title: アルテミス月面計画の政治化
alerts.description: 月面ミッション報道が33倍急増、トランプ政権の遺産戦略と結紐。単なる科学探査ではなく米国の宇宙覇権、中国との競争、産業への投資シグナルとして機能。宇宙開発が地政学的象徴化。
alerts.alert_title_en: Artemis Moon mission politicized as US space dominance marker
alerts.description_en: Artemis coverage surged 33,000%, tying NASA's lunar program to Trump's legacy ambitions. Space exploration is becoming a proxy for great power competition and industrial policy signaling.

alerts.alert_title: ビッグロー法律事務所の社会的責任転換
alerts.description: 大型法律事務所の報道が35倍急増、プロボノ活動拡大とビリングアワーの相対化を報道。トランプ政権への対抗姿勢と社会正義活動の経営統合が急加速。法律業界の価値観再編を示唆。
alerts.alert_title_en: Biglaw firms rebalancing profit and pro-bono social justice
alerts.description_en: Biglaw coverage surged 35,000%, showing major firms expanding pro-bono work and supporting cases against the Trump administration. Legal profession values are visibly recalibrating toward social responsibility.

alerts.alert_title: プライバシー権擁護運動の顕在化
alerts.description: プライバシー擁護関連が過去2年未出現から60件出現、Cindy Cohn氏のメモア出版契機。政府・企業のデータ収集拡大に対する市民的抵抗の可視化。AI時代の個人情報保護が法的・政治的争点化。
alerts.alert_title_en: Privacy advocacy movements gaining public prominence
alerts.description_en: Privacy defender narratives emerged 60 times, driven by Cindy Cohn's memoir launch. Public consciousness about data surveillance and AI ethics is rising, signaling coming privacy legislation battles.

alerts.alert_title: 米国市民権問題の司法的再審視
alerts.description: 出生地市民権訴訟関連が初出36件、最高裁判例の可能性濃厚。トランプ政権の移民政策がイデオロギー的に根本的制度変更を試行。人口動態・法制・政治が同時に揺らぐ危機的兆候。
alerts.alert_title_en: US birthright citizenship doctrine facing Supreme Court challenge
alerts.description_en: Birthright citizenship litigation emerged 36 times after absence, with the Supreme Court skeptical of restrictions. This signals potential constitutional upheaval in citizenship doctrine tied to immigration politics.

alerts.alert_title: Fed議長候補ウォーシュの指名
alerts.description: Kevin Warsh氏の議長指名関連が初出32件。130百万ドル以上の資産保有が公開、金融規制と個人利益の相克が表面化。金融政策の透明性・独立性への信頼危機が潜在。
alerts.alert_title_en: Fed chair nominee's substantial wealth raises transparency concerns
alerts.description_en: Kevin Warsh's $130M+ asset disclosure emerged 32 times following nomination. The visible wealth concentration raises questions about Federal Reserve independence and financial regulation impartiality.

alerts.description: Anthropic企業の報道が初出30件、AI安全原則修正を報道。競争激化下での原則後退と国防衛省連携の政治性が同時検出。AI規制と産業発展の緊張関係が制度化途上。
alerts.alert_title_en: Anthropic modifies AI safety principles amid defense partnerships
alerts.description_en: Anthropic coverage emerged 30 times, revealing adjustments to safety principles and DOD collaboration. The incident exposes tensions between AI governance commitments and competitive/defense pressures.

alerts.alert_title: 石油価格と政治決定の即座化
alerts.description: 石油価格関連報道が急増し、トランプ政権のイラン政策発表に先立つ疑わしい取引報道。市場操作の可能性と政治内部情報の不適切流出が同時疑わしい。市場信頼性の深刻な劣化兆候。
alerts.alert_title_en: Oil trading shows suspicious patterns ahead of Trump Iran policy shifts
alerts.description_en: Stock and oil price surges preceded Trump's Iran policy announcements, with US regulators probing suspicious trades. The pattern raises concerns about insider information flows and market integrity.
